description: Customer age in years stored as integers. Contains 30 records with no missing values and 24 distinct values. Observed range spans -5 to 66, though this includes data quality issues: 1 non-numeric text value ('Twenty-five', 3.3% of records) and 2 implausible ages (-5 and 4) that are unrealistic for service accounts.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Convert text-based number to integer format: 'Twenty-five' → 25.
[CLARIFY] Review 2 implausible age values (-5 and 4) which appear to be data entry errors or require business rule validation for minimum age.
[VALIDATE] Ensure all values are positive integers within a realistic age range (e.g., 13-120) after standardization.
